name: Alma Madrigal - Family Matriarch
en:
TO THE TABLE When you play this character, you may
search your deck for a Madrigal character card and
reveal that card to all players. Shuffle your deck and put
that card on top of it.
zh: 上桌　當你打出這個角色時，你可以在你的牌庫中搜尋一張 Madrigal 角色卡並向所有玩家展示。洗你的牌庫並將該卡放到牌庫頂。

name: Ariel - Singing Mermaid
en:
Singer 7 (This character counts as cost 7 to sing
songs.)
zh: 歌手 7（這個角色視為費用 7 來詠唱歌曲。）

name: Cinderella - Melody Weaver
en:
Singer 9 (This character counts as cost 9 to sing
songs.)
BEAUTIFUL VOICE Whenever this character sings
a song, your other Princess characters get +1 ◊
this turn.
zh:
歌手 9（這個角色視為費用 9 來詠唱歌曲。）

Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)

迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Cogsworth - Majordomo
en:
AS YOU WERE! Whenever this character quests,
you may give chosen character -2 ¤ until the
start of your next turn.
zh: 你原地待命！　每當這個角色探險時，你可以給予指定角色 -2 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

INFILTRATION When you play this character, each
opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh: 滲透　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Mickey Mouse - Playful Sorcerer
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mickey Mouse.)

chosen character equal to the number of Broom characters
you have in play.

變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色上。）
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Donald Duck - Musketeer Soldier
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)

chosen character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
等等我！　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Gaston - Despicable Dealer
en:
DUBIOUS RECRUITMENT ⟳ — You pay 2 ⬡ less
for the next character you play this turn.
zh: 可疑招募　⟳ — 你本回合打出的下一個角色少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Golden Harp - Enchanter of the Land
en:
STOLEN AWAY At the end of your turn, if you
didn't play a song this turn, banish this character.
zh: 被偷走　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合沒有打出歌，消滅這個角色。

name: Goofy - Musketeer Swordsman
en:
EN GAWRSH! Whenever you play a character with
Bodyguard, ready this character. He can't quest
for the rest of this turn.

name: Julieta Madrigal - Excellent Cook

SIGNATURE RECIPE When you play this character,
you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen
character. If you removed damage this way, you
may draw a card.
zh: 招牌食譜　當你打出這個角色時，你可以從指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。若你以此方式移除了傷害，你可以抽一張牌。

火槍手團結　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出他，你可以依你在場具護衛的角色數量抽取對應數量的牌。

合唱 7（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 7 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）

看這個！　每當你打出一首歌時，指定角色獲得 -2 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

zh: 水下音響　角色在這裡時，詠唱歌曲的費用視為增加 2。

新鮮墨水　當你打出這個物品時，抽一張牌。

(An opposing character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
zh:
足智多謀　當你打出這個物品時，你可以抽一張牌。
鋼鐵萃取　1 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 你一個指定角色獲得護衛，直到你的下個回合開始。（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Imperial Bow
en:
WITHIN RANGE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen Hero character
gains Challenger +2 and Evasive this turn. (They
get +2 ¤ while challenging. They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
zh: 在射程內　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定的英雄角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2 和迴避。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: RLS Legacy's Cannon
en:
BA-BOOM! ⟳, 2 ⬡, Discard a card — Deal 2 damage
to chosen character or location.
zh: 轟隆！　⟳，2 ⬡，棄掉一張卡 — 對指定角色或地點造成 2 點傷害。

name: The Wall - Border Fortress
en:
PROTECT THE REALM While you have an exerted character here, your
other locations can't be challenged.
zh: 守護國度　當你這裡有一個橫置的角色時，你其他的地點不能被挑戰。

name: Thebes - The Big Olive
en:
IF YOU CAN MAKE IT HERE... During your turn, whenever a character
banishes another character in a challenge while here, gain 2 lore.
zh: 在這裡能成功…　在你的回合中，每當有角色在這裡於挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Cinderella - Melody Weaver
en:
Singer 9 (This character counts as cost 9 to sing
songs.)
BEAUTIFUL VOICE Whenever this character sings
a song, your other Princess characters get +1 ◊
this turn.
zh:
歌手 9（這個角色視為費用 9 來詠唱歌曲。）
美妙的歌聲　每當這個角色詠唱一首歌時，你其他的公主角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Minnie Mouse - Musketeer Champion
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
DRAMATIC ENTRANCE When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 5 ¤ or more.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
戲劇性登場　當你打出這個角色時，消滅一個 5 ¤ 或以上的指定對方角色。

name: Look at This Family
en:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 7 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal up
to 2 character cards and put them into your hand. Put the
rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh:
合唱 7（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 7 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 5 張卡。你可以展示至多 2 張角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Ursula - Sea Witch Queen
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ursula.)
NOW I AM THE RULER! Whenever this character
quests, exert chosen character.
YOU'LL LISTEN TO ME! Other characters can't
exert to sing songs.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Ursula 的角色上。）
現在我是統治者！　每當這個角色探險時，橫置指定角色。
你們要聽我的！　其他角色不能橫置來詠唱歌曲。

name: Yen Sid - Powerful Sorcerer
en:
TIMELY INTERVENTION When you play this
character, if you have a character named Magic
Broom in play, you may draw a card.
ARCANE STUDY While you have 2 or more Broom
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh:
及時介入　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個名為 Magic Broom 的角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。
奧術研究　當你有 2 個或以上的掃帚角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Second Star to the Right
en:
Sing Together 10 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 10 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen player draws 5 cards.
zh:
合唱 10（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 10 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定玩家抽 5 張牌。

name: Diablo - Devoted Herald
en:
Shift: Discard an action card (You may discard an action card
to play this on top of one of your characters named Diablo.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
CIRCLE FAR AND WIDE During each opponent's turn,
whenever they draw a card while this character is exerted,
you may draw a card.
zh:
變身：棄掉一張行動卡（你可以棄掉一張行動卡，將這個角色打在你一個名為 Diablo 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
盤旋四方　在每位對手的回合中，當這個角色橫置時，每當他們抽一張牌，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Jasmine - Desert Warrior
en:
CUNNING MANEUVER When you play this
character and whenever she's challenged, each
opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh: 狡猾機動　當你打出這個角色以及每當她被挑戰時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: We Don't Talk About Bruno
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Return chosen character to their player's hand, then that
player discards a card at random.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌，然後該玩家隨機棄掉一張卡。

name: Goofy - Super Goof
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
SUPER PEANUT POWERS Whenever this character
challenges another character, gain 2 lore.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
超級花生力量　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Sisu - Empowered Sibling
en:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Sisu.)
I GOT THIS! When you play this character, banish
all opposing characters with 2 ¤ or less.
zh:
變身 6（你可以支付 6 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Sisu 的角色上。）
交給我！　當你打出這個角色時，消滅所有 2 ¤ 或以下的對方角色。

name: Snuggly Duckling - Disreputable Pub
en:
ROUTINE RUCKUS Whenever a character with 3 ¤ or more challenges
another character while here, gain 1 lore. If the challenging character
has 6 ¤ or more, gain 3 lore instead.
zh: 例行喧鬧　每當有 3 ¤ 或以上的角色在這裡挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。若進行挑戰的角色有 6 ¤ 或以上，改為獲得 3 點傳說值。

name: Anna - True-Hearted
en:
LET ME HELP YOU Whenever this character
quests, your other Hero characters get +1 ◊ this
turn.
zh: 讓我幫你　每當這個角色探險時，你其他的英雄角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: The Queen - Diviner
en:
CONSULT THE SPELLBOOK ⟳ — Look at the top 4
cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card
and put it into your hand. If that item costs 3 or
less, you may play it for free instead and it enters
play exerted. Put the rest on the bottom of your
deck in any order.
zh: 查閱魔法書　⟳ — 查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張物品卡並加入手牌。若該物品費用 3 或以下，你可以改為免費打出它且它橫置進場。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Ariel's Grotto - A Secret Place
en:
TREASURE TROVE While you have 3 or more items in play, this location
gets +2 ◊.
zh: 寶藏寶庫　當你有 3 個或以上的物品在場時，這個地點獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Ariel - Sonic Warrior
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ariel.)
AMPLIFIED VOICE Whenever you play a song,
you may pay 2 ⬡ to deal 3 damage to chosen
character.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Ariel 的角色上。）
擴音之聲　每當你打出一首歌時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 對指定角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Piglet - Sturdy Swordsman
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
NOT SO SMALL ANYMORE While you have no cards
in your hand, this character can challenge ready
characters.
zh:
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
不再那麼小了　當你手上沒有卡時，這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: The Wall - Border Fortress
en:
PROTECT THE REALM While you have an exerted character here, your
other locations can't be challenged.
zh: 守護國度　當你這裡有一個橫置的角色時，你其他的地點不能被挑戰。

name: Yen Sid - Powerful Sorcerer
en:
TIMELY INTERVENTION When you play this
character, if you have a character named Magic
Broom in play, you may draw a card.
ARCANE STUDY While you have 2 or more Broom
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh:
及時介入　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個名為 Magic Broom 的角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。
奧術研究　當你有 2 個或以上的掃帚角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Mulan - Elite Archer
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mulan.)
STRAIGHT SHOOTER When you play this character, if you
used Shift to play her, she gets +3 ¤ this turn.
TRIPLE SHOT During your turn, whenever this character
deals damage to another character in a challenge, deal the
same amount of damage to up to 2 other chosen characters.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mulan 的角色上。）
神準射手　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出她，她本回合獲得 +3 ¤。
三連射　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中對另一個角色造成傷害時，對至多 2 個其他指定角色造成相同數量的傷害。

name: Mickey Mouse - Playful Sorcerer
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mickey Mouse.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
SWEEP AWAY When you play this character, deal damage to
chosen character equal to the number of Broom characters
you have in play.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色上。）
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
清掃　當你打出這個角色時，對指定角色造成等同你在場掃帚角色數量的傷害。
